variants.headline: Full shelves, empty household purses
variants.body: Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Food for sale beyond the buyer's means
variants.body: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Hunger beside food that cannot be afforded
variants.body: There is food on the shelves, but people without enough money cannot obtain their meals. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
